hub.headline: Torque 3D was GarageGames' commercial game engine, descended from the engine behind Tribes 2.
hub.next: Point readers to the community repository, and confirm its licence file, which GitHub does not identify.
hub.what_it_was: A licensable engine for independent studios, with a world editor, a scripting language (TorqueScript) and networking from the Tribes lineage.
hub.what_survives: GarageGames published Torque 3D under the MIT licence in September 2012. The Torque Game Engines community continues it; its last change was on 26 September 2026.

name: Torque 3D
summary: GarageGames' engine, descended from the Tribes 2 engine, released under MIT in 2012 and continued by a community project.
